async def c(items, groups, read, a, b):
    # CASE list_basic expect=fire
    r = [await read(x) for x in items]
    # CASE list_five_filters expect=fire
    r = [await read(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4]
    # CASE set_five_filters expect=fire
    r = {await read(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4}
    # CASE dict_five_filters expect=fire
    r = {x: await read(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4}
    # CASE gen_five_filters expect=fire
    r = [y async for y in (await read(x) for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4)]
    # CASE gen_basic expect=fire
    r = sum([z async for z in (await read(x) for x in items)])
    # CASE list_first_iter_await_two_gen expect=pass
    r = [y for x in await read() for y in x]
    # CASE list_first_iter_await_five_filters expect=pass
    r = [x for x in await read() if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if x > 4]
    # CASE list_first_iter_paren expect=pass
    r = [x.id for x in (await read())]
    # CASE list_literal_one expect=pass
    r = [await read()]
    # CASE list_literal_many expect=pass
    r = [await read(a), await read(b)]
    # CASE list_over_literal expect=fire
    r = [await read(x) for x in [a, b]]
    # CASE list_over_literal_tuple expect=fire
    r = [await read(x) for x in (a, b)]
    # CASE list_cond_expr expect=fire
    r = [await read(x) if x else None for x in items]
    # CASE list_nested_call expect=fire
    r = [f(await read(x)) for x in items]
    # CASE list_in_call_arg expect=fire
    use([await read(x) for x in items if x])
    # CASE list_two_gen_await_second_iter expect=fire
    r = [y for x in items for y in await read(x)]
    # CASE list_await_in_filter_five expect=fire
    r = [x for x in items if x if x > 1 if x > 2 if x > 3 if await read(x)]
    # CASE list_unpack_await expect=pass
    r = [*await read(), a]
    # CASE subscript_await expect=pass
    r = items[await read()]
    # CASE list_of_comps expect=fire
    r = [[await read(y) for y in g] for g in groups]
